summary: Moonshadow Bridge V1 is the first deployed Bridge. Moonshadow Creative OS/editor Version 28 is a separate existing system and must be preserved. The Brain carries persistent operational memory. The Workbench carries notes and handoffs. The Task Book carries assignments and state. The Bridge carries live communication. A Checkpoint proves activity and synchronization. Planned systems and untested workers must never be reported as operational.

identity.Amber: Studio Manager, intake router, and handoff custodian
identity.Allie: Creative partner, synthesis lead, and working partner

systems.bridge: V1 REALTIME TRANSPORT OPERATIONAL — MESSAGE, CHECKPOINT, PRESENCE, AND SECOND-SESSION RETURN PATH PROVEN; WORKER DOORWAYS NOT YET VERIFIED

workflow: Josh and Allie define the brief and final creative direction
Amber receives inbound calls, texts, and emails, then routes work
Artisa performs final edit, continuity, and quality review
Slick packages, double-checks, and releases the work
Tigra drafts and manages outbound social responses
The Scout gathers free tools, APIs, and resources
Marketer finds free distribution and outreach opportunities
checkpointFormat: NAME | ROLE | TASK | STATUS | LAST ACTION | BLOCKER | NEXT ACTION | BRAIN UPDATED: YES/NO
lockedRules: Do not merge Amber and Allie
Do not rename or redesign locked systems until original locations are recovered
No production work until the worker doorway passes
Shared memory is context, not live communication

Tigra: Draft social responses and monitor engagement
The Scout: Find free tools, APIs, and bootstrap resources

proofOfConcept.name: 2–7 Agent Workcell
proofOfConcept.objective: Prove that two to seven bounded agents can coordinate through shared operational memory, assignments, handoffs, live messages, checkpoints, verification, and human escalation without drifting from the Architect's parameters.
proofOfConcept.scaleRule: Pass the complete protocol with two agents first, then add one verified worker at a time until the seven-agent workcell is proven.
evidenceRequired: Run npm install and npm run check locally
Add mock-adapter tests for A -> B -> A, duplicate delivery, invalid target, and loop cap
Create the new Cloudflare resources and record deployment and rollback notes
Test each private identity independently, then the automatic path
